concerns.text: T102, the Phase-1 checkpoint, and T110 all reference 'the sampled subject list' / 'real sampled subject list', but no task defines that list — its source (manifest? config constant?), size, or selection rule. An implementer cannot deterministically execute 'fetch real HCP data for the sampled subject list' without knowing where the sample is defined. Add the sample definition (e.g. 'subject IDs listed in data/raw/manifest.json produced by task X' or a config constant) or a task that creates it.

'the HCP S1200 OpenNeuro mirror (ds003189-style or the documented OpenNeuro HCP derivative dataset; use exact, reachable URLs recorded in code/config.py)' — the dataset identity is left as an either/or choice for the implementer. Two implementers could fetch different datasets, breaking reproducibility (Constitution I). Name the single dataset and its canonical URL in the task (or in a prerequisite artifact the task cites).

T107 says 'apply FWE correction (max-T or Bonferroni, per code/config.py) to any ROI-wise correlations', but no task in T101–T113 computes ROI-wise correlations, so the FWE branch has no input and FR-007's demonstrating command cannot exercise it. Either add the ROI-wise correlation computation as a deliverable or state explicitly that FWE is a no-op single-hypothesis case so the verification is deterministic.

T110's verification requires 'checksum assertion script exits 0', but no task creates that script and no path is given. Name the script path (e.g. code/utils/verify_checksums.py) and either add it to a task's deliverables or to T110's own description.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T112, T113 vs plan.md Project Structure
concerns.text: T112/T113 reference 'specs/001-investigating-the-relationship-between-b/research.md' and '.../data-model.md', while plan.md's structure uses 'specs/518-brain-dynamics-creativity/'. If the on-disk directory is the 001-... one (as the artifact path suggests), the plan is stale; if not, T112/T113 point at nonexistent paths. Pick one canonical spec-directory path and use it consistently so the file edits are executable.

T106's integration test 'validating the CSV schema' is ambiguous: data/interim/results.csv includes columns (pearson_r, pearson_p, model residuals fields) not present in contracts/regression_result.schema.yaml, which sets additionalProperties: false. State which schema the CSV is validated against (a dedicated CSV column spec vs the YAML contract) so the test is deterministic and won't fail on the column mismatch.

'projected full-run runtime < 6 h on 2 CPU cores' — the projection method is unspecified (linear scale from the 10-subject profile?). Name the extrapolation rule (e.g. 'per-subject mean runtime × planned N') so the profiling report's pass/fail is checkable rather than judgment-based.
